definitions.explanation: A person who creates art, particularly in the fine arts (painting, sculpture, music, literature). Implies serious artistic pursuit rather than casual creativity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{芸術家|げいじゅつか}だ。
{若|わか}い{芸術家|げいじゅつか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a system to support young artists.

examples.japanese: {芸術家|げいじゅつか}⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧な⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: He said that for an artist, free creative thinking is more important than anything else.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧ (art, fine arts) and ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional, -ist). Refers to someone who seriously practices the arts as a calling.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧ is the loanword equivalent, used more broadly and casually
- ⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧ specifically means painter
- ⟦{彫刻家|ちょうこくか}→彫刻家：07092_choukokuka⟧ specifically means sculptor
- ⟦{音楽家|おんがくか}→音楽家：27511_ongakuka⟧ specifically means musician
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか} is the broad umbrella term covering all art forms

Sometimes used figuratively to describe someone with artistic temperament or eccentricity: {芸術家|げいじゅつか}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (having the temperament of an artist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (artistic temperament)
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧{芸術家|げいじゅつか} (contemporary artist)
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (to aspire to be an artist)
